actions.action: Loosen the root ball with vertical cuts and tear the bottom mat loose
Repot at the same depth in the terracotta pot with drainage, using potting mix amended with one-third cactus/succulent mix
Water slowly until it drains out the bottom
Check soil 2 inches deep every 2-3 days and water only when dry

reason: The answer blames a root-bound plant rather than underwatering in fast-drying terracotta. It recommends keeping the terracotta pot, adding faster-draining cactus mix and watering less often, which would worsen the drying out and delay the switch to plastic that fixed it.
